title: @docgit/ui has no executable tests for its graph and diff behavior
reasoning: This package contains non-trivial layout, selection, collapsing, and multi-format diff rendering logic, but its test command always succeeds without exercising any behavior. That leaves regressions in commit ordering, click handling, and diff rendering to be caught only indirectly by the desktop smoke path.
recommendation: Replace the no-op package test with focused component tests for graph ordering/selection and DiffView text, spreadsheet, and slides rendering paths.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The package explicitly has no unit tests yet, and the feature metadata lists no linked tests.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a small React test setup for @docgit/ui and cover at least graph ancestry ordering, additive selection callbacks, collapsed text runs, modified text fallback, and spreadsheet cell rendering.
minimumFixScope: Introduce a real test script and the first focused tests for the highest-risk UI logic without changing component behavior.
